info.brief: Functions and constants for interacting with Google Play Games Services (GPGS) APIs
info.description: Functions and constants for interacting with Google Play Games Services (GPGS) APIs

elements.name: gpgs.is_supported
elements.description: Check if Google Play Services are available & ready on the device.

returnvalues.name: is_supported
returnvalues.doc: Status of Google Play Services on the device.

elements.name: gpgs.login
elements.description: Login to GPGS using a button.

elements.name: gpgs.silent_login
elements.description:
Silent login to GPGS.
This function is trying to retrieve the currently signed-in player’s account.

elements.name: gpgs.get_display_name
elements.description: Get the current GPGS player display name.

elements.name: gpgs.get_id
elements.description: Get the current GPGS player id.

elements.name: gpgs.get_server_auth_code
elements.description:
Returns a one-time server auth code to send to your web server which can be exchanged for access token
A code can be retrieved only if `gpgs.request_server_auth_code` is set to 1 and `gpgs.client_id` is set.

returnvalues.name: server_auth_code
returnvalues.doc:
The server auth code for logged in account. Can be nil if operation is not completed yet.
The auth code is available after receiving a message with id `gpgs.MSG_GET_SERVER_AUTH_CODE` in callback set via `gpgs.set_callback`.

elements.name: gpgs.is_logged_in
elements.description: Check if a user is logged in currently.

elements.name: gpgs.set_callback
elements.description: Set callback for receiving messages from GPGS.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: A callback taking the following parameters

elements.name: gpgs.snapshot_display_saves
elements.description: Provides a default saved games selection user interface.

parameters.name: popupTitle
parameters.doc: The title to display in the action bar. By default "Game Saves".

parameters.name: allowAddButton
parameters.doc: Whether or not to display a "create new snapshot" option in the selection UI. By default `true`.

parameters.name: allowDelete
parameters.doc: Whether or not to provide a delete overflow menu option for each snapshot in the selection UI. By default `true`.

parameters.name: maxNumberOfSavedGamesToShow
parameters.doc: The maximum number of snapshots to display in the UI. By default 5.

elements.name: gpgs.snapshot_open
elements.description: Opens a snapshot with the given `saveName`. If `createIfNotFound` is set to `true`, the specified snapshot will be created if it does not already exist.

parameters.name: saveName
parameters.doc: The name of the snapshot file to open. Must be between 1 and 100 non-URL-reserved characters (a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or the symbols "-", ".", "_", or "~").

parameters.name: createIfNotFound
parameters.doc: If `true`, the snapshot will be created if one cannot be found.

parameters.name: conflictPolicy
parameters.doc:
The conflict resolution policy to use for this snapshot that can be one of the predefined constants below
- `gpgs.RESOLUTION_POLICY_MANUAL`
- `gpgs.RESOLUTION_POLICY_LONGEST_PLAYTIME`
- `gpgs.RESOLUTION_POLICY_LAST_KNOWN_GOOD`
- `gpgs.RESOLUTION_POLICY_MOST_RECENTLY_MODIFIED`
- `gpgs.RESOLUTION_POLICY_HIGHEST_PROGRESS`

Default value is `gpgs.RESOLUTION_POLICY_LAST_KNOWN_GOOD`

elements.name: gpgs.snapshot_commit_and_close
elements.description: Save the currently opened save on the server and close it.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.doc: A table with metadata for a save. It contains the fields below

elements.name: gpgs.snapshot_get_data
elements.description: Returns the currently opened snapshot data.

returnvalues.name: bytes
returnvalues.doc: The byte array data of the currently opened snapshot. `nil` if something goes wrong.

returnvalues.name: error_message
returnvalues.doc: An error message if something goes wrong.

elements.name: gpgs.snapshot_set_data
elements.description: Sets the data for the currently opened snapshot.

returnvalues.name: success
returnvalues.doc: True if data was set for the currently opened snapshot.

returnvalues.name: error_message
returnvalues.doc: An error message if something goes wrong.

elements.name: gpgs.snapshot_is_opened
elements.description: Check if a snapshot was opened.

elements.name: gpgs.snapshot_get_max_image_size
elements.description: Returns the maximum data size per snapshot cover image in bytes.

returnvalues.name: image_size
returnvalues.doc: The maximum data size per snapshot cover image in bytes.

elements.name: gpgs.snapshot_get_max_save_size
elements.description: Returns the maximum data size per snapshot in bytes.

returnvalues.name: data_size
returnvalues.doc: The maximum data size per snapshot in bytes.

elements.name: gpgs.snapshot_get_conflicting_data
elements.description: Returns the conflicting snapshot data.

returnvalues.name: bytes
returnvalues.doc: The byte array data of the conflicting snapshot. `nil` if something goes wrong.

returnvalues.name: error_message
returnvalues.doc: An error message if something goes wrong.

elements.name: gpgs.snapshot_resolve_conflict
elements.description: Resolves a conflict using the data from the provided snapshot.

parameters.name: conflictId
parameters.doc: The conflict id that you want to resolve. Provided in `message` table with `STATUS_CONFLICT` message type.

parameters.name: snapshotId
parameters.doc:
Type of the snapshot you want to use for conflict solving that can be one of the predefined constants below
- `gpgs.SNAPSHOT_CURRENT`
- `gpgs.SNAPSHOT_CONFLICTING`

elements.name: gpgs.leaderboard_submit_score
elements.description: Submit a score to a leaderboard for the currently signed-in player.

elements.name: gpgs.leaderboard_get_top_scores
elements.description: Asynchronously gets the top page of scores for a leaderboard. The callback receives an array of JSON strings with score data; decode each string with `json.decode()`.

elements.name: gpgs.leaderboard_get_player_centered_scores
elements.description: Asynchronously gets a player-centered page of scores for a leaderboard. The callback receives an array of JSON strings with score data; decode each string with `json.decode()`.

parameters.name: force_reload
parameters.doc: If true, this call will clear any locally cached data and attempt to fetch the latest data from the server

elements.name: gpgs.leaderboard_show
elements.description: Show a leaderboard for a game specified by a leaderboardId.

elements.name: gpgs.leaderboard_list
elements.description: Show the list of leaderboards.

elements.name: gpgs.leaderboard_get_player_score
elements.description: Asynchronously gets the current player's score for a leaderboard. The callback receives the score fields directly in the message table.

elements.name: gpgs.achievement_reveal
elements.description: Reveals a hidden achievement to the current player.

elements.name: gpgs.achievement_unlock
elements.description: Unlocks an achievement for the current player.

elements.name: gpgs.achievement_set
elements.description: Sets an achievement to have at least the given number of steps completed.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.doc: The number of steps to set the achievement to. Must be greater than 0.

elements.name: gpgs.achievement_increment
elements.description: Increments an achievement by the given number of steps.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.doc: The number of steps to increment by. Must be greater than 0.

elements.name: gpgs.achievement_show
elements.description: Show achivements

elements.name: gpgs.achievement_get
elements.description:
Get information about all achievement's state asynchronously. Result return to callback previously set by `gpgs.set_callback` with `message_id == gpgs.MSG_GET_ACHIEVEMENTS`. Result is an array of JSON strings. Decode each string with `json.decode()` to get a table containing the following fields
- `id` - achievement id (from GP console)
- `name` - achievement name
- `description` - achievement description
- `xp` - how much experience points will be added when achievement will be unlocked
- `steps` - current step of incremental achievement
- `total_steps` - total amount of steps of incremental achievement
- `unlocked` - set to `true` if achievement is unlocked. Otherwise field is missed.
- `hidden` - set to `true if achievement is hidden. Otherwise field is missed.
- `revealed` - set to `true` if achievement is revealed. Otherwise field is missed.

elements.name: gpgs.event_increment
elements.description: Increments an event specified by `eventId` by the given number of steps

parameters.name: amount
parameters.doc: The amount increment by. Must be greater than or equal to 0

elements.name: gpgs.event_get
elements.description:
Get information about all events asynchronously. Result returns to callback previously set by `gpgs.set_callback` with `message_id == gpgs.MSG_GET_EVENTS`. Result is an array of JSON strings. Decode each string with `json.decode()` to get a table containing the following fields
- `id` - event id
- `formatted_value` - sum of all increments have been made to this event
- `value` - the number of increments this user has made to this event
- `description` - event's description
- `image` - URI that can be used to load the event's image icon
- `name` - event's name
- `visible` - whether the event should be displayed to the user in any event related UIs
